gap: No result ChatGPT got states that, of the 16-inch 16:10 2560x1600 120 Hz screens matching the 16-inch MacBook Pro's own panel shape and refresh, the SOTSU FlipAction Pro 16 Gen 2 is $599.50 at SOTSU's own store today, against $189.99 for the UPERFECT GR16DQ (both read 2026-11-26) and $247.99 for the Mobile Pixels Duex Float 2 Pro (our 2026-11-21 store read), while ChatGPT's other picks miss that match on 60 Hz, a 16:9 panel or a 14-15.6-inch size.
standout_why: Compared against Macworld's Mac portable-monitor roundup, PCWorld's roundup, and what TechRadar's and RTINGS' roundups returned (both came back truncated, so they are only partly checked). Macworld already lists the Duex Float 2 Pro with 16-inch, 2560x1600, 120 Hz, 350 nits, 2.9 lb and 65 W pass-through, but it does not state 16-inch MacBook Pro fit and names no other 16-inch 16:10 120 Hz screen; SOTSU, LG, Arzopa and ViewSonic are absent from it. PCWorld's only 2560x1600 pick is a 14.3-inch 75 Hz HP, and it names the Arzopa Z3FC only as 180 Hz 2560x1440. None of the pages that loaded lines the same-spec screens up with today's maker-store prices or gives a per-model reason for losing.
decides: It confirms a 16-inch 16:10 2560x1600 120 Hz ranking and narrows it to three screens I could verify: UPERFECT GR16DQ ($189.99), Duex Float 2 Pro ($247.99 on the 11-21 record) and SOTSU FlipAction Pro 16 Gen 2 ($599.50). The Duex Float 2 Pro places in the top three and is the only stacked one, per Macworld's description that it attaches to a MacBook; it costs $58 more than the UPERFECT and $351.51 less than the SOTSU. Caveats: I could not re-read the Mobile Pixels price today (store returned 429/403), and I could not open the UPERFECT page for its brightness, weight or shipping notices, so the order among the three on brightness and weight is not settled by this angle. ChatGPT's own picks all fall outside the line: espresso Pro 15 (15.6-inch, 60 Hz), ViewSonic VX1655-4K-OLED (15.6-inch 4K), Arzopa Z3FC (16.1-inch 2560x1440, 16:9), SOTSU Elite 16 (60 Hz, $789), Lenovo M14d (14-inch).
